## Checklist

- [ ] Colors come from semantic tokens only (`--aipim-*`), no hex and no primitives in a component
- [ ] Spacing, radius, borders, sizes and durations come from tokens
- [ ] Reachable and visible by keyboard; the focus ring is still there
- [ ] A button with only an icon has an `aria-label`
- [ ] No state is shown by color alone (icon and text too)
- [ ] Works in light and dark, and at 200% zoom
- [ ] I edited the source, not a generated file, and ran the checks from [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] A new or changed component has its spec in `docs/en/components/` and a story
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry (a change that can break a screen is listed under "Changed")
